protocol.reported_optimizer_results: feasible upper bounds only; no Wilks p-values, global optima or continuous theta confidence intervals
protocol.calibration_transfer: none, including the two Nairobi epochs
protocol.leakage_cap_interpretation: sensitivity choices, not independently measured calibration limits
